print_config_tree: print a Hydra DictConfig as a Rich tree structure with optional YAML resolution and file export
print_config_tree_save: print a Hydra DictConfig as a Rich tree and save the output to a log file in the output directory
print_config_tree_resolve: print a Hydra DictConfig as a Rich tree with resolved reference fields for debugging config interpolation
enforce_tags_prompt: prompt the user to enter comma-separated tags when a Hydra config has no tags defined
enforce_tags_save: enforce tags on a Hydra DictConfig and save the resulting tags list to a log file
